 Stray Dogs Tour 2027: Dates, Tickets & Venues
 October 28, 2026 
 Key Takeaways
 Nothing But Thieves Stray Dogs World Tour runs from January 12, 2027 in Paris to April 21, 2027 in Toronto, covering 38 headline dates across Europe, the UK, Ireland, and North America.
 North American shows are in intimate 2,700–4,000 capacity theatres and ballrooms, a clear contrast to the 17,000–23,000 capacity arenas used in Europe and the UK.
 Amsterdam’s Ziggo Dome (both nights) and Antwerp’s AFAS Dome sold out immediately, signaling strong demand that could accelerate sell-outs on the North American leg.
 Stray Dogs, the band’s fifth studio album released September 25, 2026, was written and produced as a live-show concept album, so the 2027 setlist is expected to draw heavily from it in sequence.
 OnesToWatch Live carries first-party affiliate ticket links for every North American date, which provides a safe and straightforward purchase path.

 North American Theatre And Ballroom Dates (March–April 2027)
 The North American leg runs from March 30 through April 21, 2027 and keeps the band in theatres, ballrooms, and historic rooms. Capacities range from roughly 2,700–2,800 (Paramount Theatre Seattle, Fox Theater Oakland, Brooklyn Paramount) up to about 4,000 (Hollywood Palladium, Mission Ballroom). This design contrasts with the arenas and sheds anchoring the European and UK legs. OnesToWatch Live carries first-party affiliate ticket links for every date below.  Quick Verdict
 Nothing But Thieves Stray Dogs World Tour pairs theatre-scale North American dates with first-party ticket links for all 17 shows. The tour runs from January 12, 2027 in Paris through April 21, 2027 in Toronto, spanning continental Europe, the UK and Ireland, and North America across 13 countries.
 Watch on YouTube 
 Continental Europe – 14 Dates (January 2027)
 The tour opens in continental Europe across 14 headline shows at arena-scale venues. Both January 15 and January 16 dates at Amsterdam's Ziggo Dome sold out immediately. The January 31 date at Antwerp's AFAS Dome also sold out. The venue holds up to 23,001 in its 'in the round' configuration with a standing arena floor, while seated configurations are smaller. For tickets on remaining European dates, visit nbthieves.com/events .

 UK & Ireland – 7 Dates (February 2027)
 The UK and Ireland leg places the band at some of the country's largest indoor venues, including The O2 in London and Co-Op Live in Manchester. According to the OVO Hydro in Glasgow, tickets for the Glasgow date are priced between £56.70 and £117.05 before booking fees. That range is expected to be similar across most UK dates, though at least one venue (bp pulse LIVE Birmingham) lists £46.00–£65.00 plus fees. Tickets are available via nbthieves.com/events .

 Past Festivals And Special Appearances (Summer 2026)
 Several festival appearances listed alongside the Stray Dogs World Tour announcement fall in summer 2026 and sit outside the 2027 headline run. These include Bergenfest (June 11, 2026), Rock for People (June 13, 2026), Hurricane Festival (June 20, 2026), Southside Festival (June 21, 2026), Open Air St. Gallen (June 25–28, 2026), Ejekt Festival in Athens (July 15, 2026), Electric Castle in Cluj (July 18, 2026), and support slots with Biffy Clyro at Finsbury Park in London (July 3, 2026) and Royal Highland Showgrounds in Edinburgh (August 21, 2026). No 2027 festival dates have been announced. The band has indicated that additional North and South American dates, as well as Australian dates, are planned.
 Album Context: Stray Dogs
 Nothing But Thieves' fifth studio album Stray Dogs was released September 25, 2026 via RCA/Sony Music. The 12-track record was produced entirely by the band's Dom Craik, a first for the group, and engineered by Mark Rankin, whose credits include Queens of the Stone Age and Iggy Pop. The band wrote Stray Dogs together over a dedicated five-month period and recorded it at Angelic Studios, the same studio where they made their debut record. The record is structured to run like a night on stage, deliberately blurring the lines between a studio LP and a live show. That sequencing choice shapes how the 2027 tour is expected to unfold.
 Tour Patterns And Room-Size Takeaways
 The tour operates as two distinct designs. The 2027 European and UK headline arena shows are at 17,000–23,000 capacity venues, including Amsterdam's Ziggo Dome, Antwerp's AFAS Dome and London's O2 Arena, while other dates on the same tour include smaller venues below 10,000 capacity. North American dates stay in theatres and ballrooms of roughly 2,700–4,000 capacity.
 Amsterdam (both nights) and Antwerp sold out immediately, signaling strong demand that could accelerate sell-outs on the North American leg. That demand signal builds on the band's previous Dead Club City World Tour, which included two sold-out nights at Wembley Arena. The Stray Dogs run steps up to The O2 and Co-Op Live in the UK.
 North American rooms like the Roxian Theatre (~1,400 cap.) and The Fillmore Minneapolis (~1,500 cap. Music Hall) are among the most intimate spaces on the run. The window to see the band at this scale is narrow, especially compared with the European arenas. Stray Dogs was designed as a live-show concept album, so the 2027 setlist is likely to run through it in sequence.
 How To Buy Tickets
 For all 17 North American dates, the first-party affiliate links above connect directly to Ticketmaster or the official venue ticketing partner. That route provides the safest and most straightforward purchase path. For European and UK/Ireland dates, the official channel is nbthieves.com/events.
 Resale platforms also carry Nothing But Thieves tour ticket inventory, but coverage varies. StubHub lists only UK dates (6 events), Vivid Seats shows 23 upcoming shows, and TicketNetwork covers a subset of venues. Resale prices run meaningfully above face value. Resale tickets for Nothing But Thieves at the Hollywood Palladium on April 4, 2027 have been listed from approximately $74 to $84 for General Admission on StubHub, and resale tickets for the April 12, 2027 Salt Shed Indoors show in Chicago have been listed from about $62 to $108 on StubPass. Time Out advises buyers to exercise extra care when purchasing from secondary ticket sites.
 Prioritize the smallest-capacity North American rooms, including the Roxian Theatre, The Fillmore Minneapolis, and SOMA San Diego. These venues are the most likely to sell through first.
 Frequently Asked Questions
 When Does The Nothing But Thieves Stray Dogs World Tour Start And End? 
 The tour opens January 12, 2027 at the Zénith in Paris, France, and concludes April 21, 2027 at Massey Hall in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. The European leg runs through January, the UK and Ireland leg through February, and the North American leg from late March through late April.
 How Many Dates Are On The Stray Dogs World Tour? 
 The headline itinerary spans 38 dates: 14 in continental Europe, 7 in the UK and Ireland, and 17 in North America. The band has indicated additional dates for North and South America and Australia are planned but not yet announced.
 Which Nothing But Thieves North American Shows Are In The Smallest Venues? 
 The Roxian Theatre in McKees Rocks, PA holds approximately 1,400 (as stated on its official website and Live Nation, though some sources cite 1,470), making it the most intimate room on the North American leg. The Fillmore Minneapolis's Music Hall is listed at roughly 1,500 capacity, while the full venue can accommodate up to 1,850 guests. The Hollywood Palladium in Hollywood, CA accommodates private events of 50 to 3,700 guests, though its general-admission concert capacity is listed at 4,000, and The Salt Shed's indoor performance hall, The Shed, in Chicago holds 3,600, which still sits well below the arenas anchoring the European leg.
 What Album Is The Stray Dogs World Tour Supporting? 
 Stray Dogs, Nothing But Thieves' fifth studio album, was released September 25, 2026 via RCA/Sony Music. The 12-track record was produced entirely by the band's Dom Craik and engineered by Mark Rankin. It follows Dead Club City, the band's first UK number one album, released in 2023. Singles released ahead of the album include “Evolution,” the title track “Stray Dogs,” “Baby Kool (Evelyn),” and “A Different Kind of Happiness.”
 Are Any Stray Dogs World Tour Dates Sold Out? 
 Both Amsterdam Ziggo Dome dates (January 15 and 16, 2027) and the Antwerp AFAS Dome date (January 31, 2027) sold out immediately following the announcement. Smaller-capacity rooms on the North American leg are the most likely to move quickly.
 Final Take
 The Stray Dogs World Tour combines arena-scale shows in Europe and the UK with theatre-scale rooms across North America, and OnesToWatch Live links directly to first-party tickets for every North American date. The band's previous tour sold out Wembley Arena, and this run steps up to The O2 and Co-Op Live in the UK while keeping North America in rooms of roughly 2,700 to 4,000, a gap that will close as demand grows. Acting early on the North American dates secures a rare theatre-level view of a band already scaling to arenas elsewhere.
